project: user-service (blueprint de sistema de usuários — Java + Spring)

gateway.role: Único ponto de entrada externo; cliente OAuth2 do BFF; rate limiting; CSRF; TokenRelay

authorization-server.role: OAuth2 Authorization Server (authorization_code + PKCE + refresh + OIDC); customiza JWT; lockout

user-service.role: Domínio central: CRUD de usuários; canal interno para o auth-server; outbox + cliente Feign do notification-service (ADR-015)

notification-service.role: Envio de e-mail de verificação de cadastro (ADR-015); stateless; nunca exposto pelo gateway

config-server.role: Config centralizada (HA atrás de config-lb/nginx); HTTP Basic

login-interface.role: SPA React no padrão BFF; nunca manuseia JWT

communication.sync: REST via OpenFeign (auth-server -> user-service /internal/users/email/{email}; user-service -> notification-service /internal/notifications/email-verification)
communication.resilience: Resilience4j circuit breaker + fallback factory em ambos os clientes Feign
communication.async: outbox no MongoDB do user-service (notificationOutbox) + chamada Feign disparada via @Async — sem poller/scan periódico, sem Kafka/broker (ADR-015)
